products.name: Entra ID Governance — Access Reviews & Entitlement Management — Commercial
products.short_description: Automate the access lifecycle — Entra ID Governance access reviews, entitlement management, and lifecycle workflows.
products.description:
Automate the access lifecycle — Entra ID Governance access reviews, entitlement management, and lifecycle workflows.

Access sprawl is inevitable without governance: guests never leave, roles accumulate, and audits fail. This solution deploys Entra ID Governance — entitlement management access packages, recurring access reviews, and joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle workflows — so access is requested, approved, reviewed, and revoked automatically.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Entitlement management — access packages, catalogs, and approval policies
  • Recurring access reviews for groups, apps, and guests
  • Lifecycle workflows — automated joiner/mover/leaver tasks
  • Guest governance and time-bound external access
  • Reporting for audit and recertification evidence

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A self-governing access lifecycle — least-privilege maintained automatically, with audit-ready recertification evidence.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTIGA-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Entra ID Governance objects (read-only, Microsoft Graph)
    • ENTIGA-GuestReview.ps1 — report guest accounts + stale-access preview (read-only / -WhatIf)
    • ENTIGA-Lifecycle.ps1 — lifecycle-workflow run history, trigger-attribute readiness, on-demand run preview
    • ENTIGA-Report.ps1 — export audit / recertification evidence (read-only, Microsoft Graph)
    • ENTIGA-Validate.ps1 — validate the named ENTIGA governance objects are present and wired (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
